purpose: Check the complete bilingual teacher-facing comparison layer for wording and evidence problems that would mislead teachers.

checks.test: No promotional positioning, product hype, sales slogans or AI-style filler in the teacher-facing comparison records.
checks.notes: Comparison records use instructional verbs and short factual explanations. Words such as efficient are used only as mathematical/method-selection descriptions, not promotional claims.

checks.test: No record treats matching grade/year numbers as automatic curriculum equivalence.
checks.notes: Records describe explicit concept progression and repeatedly allow China Grade/learning-stage comparisons with different England Years or Common Core Grades.

checks.test: Statutory English curriculum is described as England, not as a single UK primary curriculum.
checks.notes: Teacher-facing records use England. Internal source IDs may retain uk- for compatibility; this is not user-facing jurisdiction wording.

checks.test: Common Core is not described as the single nationwide US curriculum.
checks.notes: Records consistently use Common Core/Common Core Grades and explicitly identify nonmatches instead of claiming universal US requirements.

checks.test: Exact current PEP grade/semester placement is not asserted where only learning-stage or partial current-series evidence exists.
checks.notes: Relevant records state that current PEP grade/volume/semester placement remains pending verification. Legacy PEP evidence is not used as current.

checks.test: Curriculum/guidance evidence is not converted into claims that all teachers in a country routinely use a particular method or representation.
checks.notes: Representation and teaching-method wording refers to curriculum/guidance/materials or presents a classroom option, not national frequency.

checks.test: Earlier/later placement is not presented as better/worse.
checks.notes: Timing differences are described as progression differences. Explicit wording states that earlier introduction is not treated as superior.

checks.test: High-risk translation terms follow the terminology glossary.
notes: bar model remains 条形模型（bar model） rather than being silently equated with 线段图.
Common Core line plot is explicitly distinguished from 折线统计图 / line graph.
England Year N and Common Core Grade N remain jurisdiction-specific labels.
fluency is treated as mathematical fluency/熟练度, not speed alone.

checks.test: Frameworks without a formal primary probability strand are not given invented standards.
checks.notes: England primary and Common Core Grades 1-6 probability nonmatches are stated directly.

checks.test: China primary circle/transformations content is not forced into unsupported Common Core Grades 1-6 equivalents.
checks.notes: Circle measurement, translation and rotation records explicitly state where no direct Common Core primary requirement exists.

ongoing_rules: Run this audit again whenever teacher-facing comparison copy is materially changed.
A wording audit does not replace source verification; source-status gates remain authoritative.
New copy must use the bilingual terminology and grade-resolution rules.
